purpose: How model-written cases fail. FM-01 to FM-08 are the eight modes in 'Mystery Engine Design Research', Track 6, 'Catalog of LLM Mystery-Writing Failure Modes and Engineering Mitigations'. FM-09 and FM-10 are kit additions. Each lists the stage where it starts, the mitigation built into the prompts, and the checks that catch it.

modes.name: The helpful explainer leak (over-explaining)
modes.symptom: A document states the cross-document deduction instead of the raw observation.
modes.mitigation: One document at a time with only its assigned facts; 'state only the raw observation' in every prose brief; claims list; the blind-solver audit's single-document probe.

modes.name: Flattened assistant voices
modes.symptom: Every department and person writes in the same polite mid-register.
modes.mitigation: Four style profiles with hard syntactic and lexical rules and two exemplars each; a voice sample for every named person.

modes.name: Convenient smoking-gun confessions
modes.symptom: A diary entry or message states the act outright.
modes.mitigation: No single fact equals an option; every option needs at least two circumstantial facts; confession phrases banned.

modes.name: Repetitive tropes and default archetypes
modes.symptom: The same cliches and stock names (melting ice, twins, blackmail over an affair, stock name pairs).
modes.mitigation: Python samples the pattern, mechanism, names and stakes before any model call, against a used-seeds ledger; trope and name ban lists.

modes.name: Timeline and alibi sloppiness
modes.symptom: Times, intervals or codes drift between documents.
modes.mitigation: Critical strings chosen by Python and injected verbatim; exact preservation and name drift checks.

modes.name: Dangling red herrings
modes.symptom: Suspicious details with no innocent explanation.
modes.mitigation: Every false lead rests on a secondary-secret fact that another document resolves.

modes.name: Option-set giveaway phrasing
modes.symptom: The correct option is longer, more specific or more nuanced.
modes.mitigation: Options written blind to correctness; length within 15 percent; every distractor names a real entity; options-only shortcut probe.

modes.name: Cross-department omniscience
modes.symptom: An author refers to something they could not know.
modes.mitigation: Each document's brief holds only what its author could know: its assigned facts, the author's sheet, and a facts-free index of other documents.

modes.name: Cardboard cast and wallpaper world (kit addition)
modes.symptom: People exist only as suspects; quirks stand in for character; world documents are decoration.
modes.mitigation: Person sheets and tests; voice samples; page presence rules; every document has an author, a reader and an in-world reason; world documents fused with a person and capped in length.

modes.name: Overreach (kit addition)
modes.symptom: Too many suspects, places, codes, documents or threads for one sitting.
modes.mitigation: Cognitive budget and document count are data and are checked before any prose exists.
